title: Statistical Test Module Compiler
description: Compiles statistical hypothesis testing scripts. Enforces hypothesis documentation, sample size adequacy, correct test selection (parametric/non-parametric), effect size reporting alongside p-value, confidence intervals, and multiple testing correction.

error_codes.ST002: Null and alternative hypotheses not documented
error_codes.ST003: No sample size or power analysis — test may be underpowered
error_codes.ST004: Test selection not justified (parametric vs non-parametric choice undocumented)
error_codes.ST005: No effect size reported (Cohen's d, r, eta-squared, odds ratio)
error_codes.ST006: No confidence intervals reported alongside p-value
error_codes.ST007: p-value used as sole decision criterion — must report effect size and CI
